div.p: In collaboration with TRE Scotland. 2.5 days online, 18–20 June 2027, led by Isabelle Claus Teixeira, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer, with Vicki Cook. Small group, limited to 15 participants. Early bird £488 until 31 May 2027.

figure.figcaption: Tap to open the full-size poster to save or share it.

div.p: TRE™ (Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises) was developed by Dr. David Berceli. It activates the body's natural neurogenic tremoring mechanism, a reflex that releases stored stress and trauma, builds resilience and promotes deep regulation.

Module 1 qualifies you to use TRE™ for your personal practice. With Modules 2 and 3 you become a Certified Global TRE™ Provider. This is the only TRE™ training anywhere in the world that carries ICF CCEUs: 21 CCEUs (16 Resource Development + 5 Core Competencies), issued on attendance and completion of the full 2.5 days.
A small group, limited to 15 participants, led by a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer with an assisting provider, in English.

ul.li: Coaches (in training, or at ACC, PCC or MCC level) looking for an ICF-accredited somatic tool
Therapists, psychologists and healthcare professionals expanding a trauma-informed practice
Yoga and Pilates teachers, bodyworkers and somatic practitioners
Anyone with chronic stress or burnout who is ready for a body-led approach
Anyone considering the full Global TRE™ Provider Certification

div.p: All sessions run on Zoom. Joining details are sent to registered participants only.

div.strong: Self-Care & Presence for Coaches · Fri 18 June 2027 · 2:00–5:00 PM
div.p: An introductory afternoon on nervous system regulation and self-induced therapeutic tremoring, with TRE™ as a personal resilience and self-care practice.

div.strong: TRE™ Module 1 — Part 1 · Sat 19 June 2027 · 9:30 AM–6:00 PM
div.p: The neuroscience of neurogenic tremoring, the TRE™ exercise sequence, somatic awareness, containment and grounding. Guided full TRE™ sessions with direct feedback from the trainers.

div.strong: TRE™ Module 1 — Part 2 & Completion · Sun 20 June 2027 · 9:30 AM–6:00 PM
div.p: Deepen the practice, integrate the learning and complete Module 1, with Q&A, personal practice time and guidance toward Modules 2 and 3.

ul.li: Module 1 Certification, valid as Module 1 of the Global TRE™ Provider Certification Program
2.5 training days, including the Day 1 afternoon workshop for coaches
Worldwide recognition under the Global TRE™ Certification Program
Small group of up to 15 participants

div.p: The individual TRE™ sessions are not included. You can add personal TRE™ sessions at £85 per session.
All prices in British pounds (GBP).

div.h2: Taught by Isabelle Claus Teixeira with Vicki Cook

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC
div.p: Accredited by TRE™ for All under Dr. David Berceli's methodology — the highest level of qualification to certify new TRE™ Providers worldwide. Over 30 years of human development experience and somatic practice, training practitioners across Europe, Asia, the US and beyond.

TRE™ Certification Trainer for over 10 years, with 15 years of her own TRE™ practice and amazing results. Health Coach since 2002, focusing on self-care and recovery from burnout, chronic fatigue and stress.
Taught in collaboration with TRE Scotland.
18–20 June 2027, online, UK time. Early bird £488 until 31 May 2027, then £589. Limited to 15 participants. Leave your details and Isabelle will contact you to confirm your place.
